name: Deja Lamarre
source:
Urban & Environmental Planning Major, Year 2

Your roommate, best friend, de-facto leader of your little friend group, and vice president of the Student Government. Deja's hellishly busy because she knows she's the person who gets things done best. She's sharp at times, but you know something a lot of people don't: that she's got a soft heart, which she takes care to protect.

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/keyframes]itch.io[/url]]
